messages:
morgan: Handoff for VIP customer OrchidMed — their SLA-backed integration goes live tomorrow 09:00 PDT. I'm covering until 08:30 and leaving notes here. Major risks: planned 09:30 load test (10k RPS for 15m) + first-hour spike from their ingestion pipeline. We have Dedicated reservation + burst enabled but watch error rate.
oncall-bot: Reminder: scheduled loadtest job #789 -> prod at 2026-03-18T09:30:00Z (owner: orchid-infra)
kai: Thanks Morgan. Quick q — which model variants are pinned for their traffic? Any fallback route? :eyes:
morgan: Primary: rwd-llama-70b-quant (v4). Canary: rwd-llama-13b-quant (v2) on region us-west-2. Fallback policy: if p95 gen latency > 600ms OR model OOM (kube eviction), route to canary variant and enable 2x batching throttle. Rollback knob: API param header x-redwood-fallback=off to force primary.
omar: Noted. I've left a canary gate in the console with 5% traffic for first 10m post-launch. If latency/p95 spikes, manual increase to 20% then 100% fallback if errors persist. Also pre-warmed KV cache on two servers.
rachel: I've run a quick smoke on staging with a 5k RPS blast earlier — saw token-level cost spike but latency within SLO. Logged the prompt set that regresses at long contexts: /playbooks/orchidmed/prompt-regressions.md. Flagging for product to review.
stephanie: Ops contacts for the window: oncall@redwood.io, +1-415-555-0199 (pager duty), and orchid-infra slack channel. If the customer reports 504s, first check model allocation and autoscaler logs.
morgan: Handoff checklist (short):
```
- Confirm Dedicated pool shows reserved GPUs 6/6
- Canary route enabled in console (5%)
- KV cache warmed and persisted
- Alert thresholds: p50>200ms, p95>600ms, error rate>0.5%
- Fallback configured to canary + notify customer via webhook
```

morgan: Known quirks: on longer prompts (>4k tokens) we see higher memory churn on 70b quant builds. If we hit OOMs, the plan is to reduce max_tokens to 1024 for OrchidMed traffic and escalate to infra for fast node replace.
kai: If autoscaler fails to add nodes (seen once last month), what's the manual step? omar?
omar: Manual: scale deployment via console or `redwoodctl scale --pool orchid-dedicated --replicas 8`. If pods pending for >3m, check node group quota in cloud console and open support ticket (internal runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/infra/scale-issues).
morgan: I'll be reachable by DM until 08:30 and on pager after that. If someone else picks up the watch, please post a short note here with time and any handoff items. :thumbsup:
stephanie: I'll cover 08:30–12:30. Will ping here at 08:25 with status. Leaving my mobile in case: +1-415-555-0123.
kai: I'll shadow the first 30m of the loadtest and monitor tracing dashboards (model/route/kv). Will post key metrics every 5m.
oncall-bot: Reminder: next scheduled post-test soak check at 2026-03-18T10:10:00Z (auto-run smoke suite).
morgan: One last FYI — there's a contract SLA clause for 4ms tail latency on embeddings requests for OrchidMed (separate path). Embeddings traffic is routed to dedicated-embeds cluster; I verified reserves but watch for cross-cluster network errors.
stephanie: Copy. I'll add embeddings dashboard to my watchlist. Anything else? :slightly_smiling_face:
morgan: That's it. Thanks team — will drop a final note after the handover completes.
